content:
Starting with iOS 26.4, Apple has supported conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category includes AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will join CarPlay starting with iOS 27. This iPhone software update is currently in beta and is set to officially launch in September.

Meanwhile, a fourth third-party AI chatbot now supports Apple CarPlay: Meta AI.

Meta AI iPhone app now supports Apple CarPlay — with one limitation

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app now supports CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps that already support CarPlay: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, Meta AI on CarPlay still appears to be in a limited testing phase.

Although the iPhone app shows up on CarPlay, launching it may currently display an "unsupported" message.

At least for me, launching the CarPlay app shows the message: "The Meta AI experience isn't supported on your account."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see whether a paid account is required to use CarPlay. However, the message in the Meta AI CarPlay app didn't change. Your experience may vary.

In any case, even before Siri AI officially rolls out to everyone, it's still exciting to see a fourth major chatbot app join CarPlay.

That's the main strength of CarPlay: integrating your existing iPhone apps with your car. You don't get this kind of rich selection with a built-in infotainment system.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also arrived on Mac. The desktop version is significantly more powerful than the iPhone and iPad apps.
